item.description:
Originally published Wed 28 Oct 2026 19:17 IST.
Wegen der Vergewaltigung von insgesamt 14 Frauen wurde am Mittwoch ein Mann vom Berliner Landgericht zu zwölf Jahren Freiheitsstrafe verurteilt. Nach Verbüßung der Haft muss er in Sicherheitsverwahrung. Außerdem: KI-Videoüberwachung am Kottbusser Tor. Wolfsattacke im Tiergehege. Juli Zeh hört als Richterin auf. Rüstung in Brandenburg.   "DER TAG in Berlin und Brandenburg" – kompakt und informativ mit dem Neuesten aus Ihrer Region. Abonnieren und hören können Sie den Podcast in ARD Sounds. item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Wed 18:28): Dozens killed in train crash in Spain
item.description:
Originally published Wed 28 Oct 2026 18:28 IST.

More than 60 people have died after two high-speed trains collided south of the Spanish capital, Madrid. The accident happened on the same rail line where 46 people died earlier this year.

Also: with most votes counted in the Israeli election, Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc is slightly ahead, but short of a majority. A luxury cruise ship on a years-long voyage around the world has suspended operations because of high fuel costs, leaving passengers stranded in Cambodia. King Charles has begun his tour of the Caribbean by acknowledging the "great suffering of the past" as he faced calls for slavery reparations. And the two-time Oscar winner, Michael Douglas, tells the BBC that writing a memoir was an important legacy to leave his “nepo baby” children.
